thread:
incident-bot: Paging @Oncall-Maya — SEV1 detected for org=Zephyr. Metrics: sustained 5xx spike, 99th latency up 4x, QPS from org jumped ~x10. Link: https://dash.internal/redwood/zephyr/overview :rotating_light:
Oncall-Maya: taking this. joining grafana now. any customer context?@AE-Sam?
AE-Sam: Zephyr on contract tier Standard; they have a heavy background job that kicks off hourly. I pinged their infra lead but no response yet.
SRE-Josh: looking at tail logs — they're hammering /v1/generate with long-seq prompts, KV cache miss rate spiked. Error pattern: upstream token allocation failures and 429s from our org-shaper.
SRE-Josh: quick read: org zephyr QPS peaked ~12k over last 3m, baseline ~1k. This is starting to affect node CPU and global latency SLOs. Recommend immediate per-org emergency soft cap to protect other customers.
Oncall-Maya: Agreed. Suggest a temporary org-level rate cap of 300 qps (burst 600) + enable prefix caching for long seqs for them. Can we push via infractl?
SRE-Josh: Yes. Command:```
infractl rate update --scope org --org-id zephyr --limit-qps 300 --burst 600 --mode soft --reason "emergency protect cluster during spike"
```
Oncall-Maya: running now.
ops-bot: Executing: infractl rate update --scope org --org-id zephyr --limit-qps 300 --burst 600 --mode soft --reason "emergency protect cluster during spike"
ops-bot: OK — config pushed to rate-manager (change-id: ch_2026_zephyr_001). Propagating to edge in 12s.
Oncall-Maya: propagation ok. initial effect: QPS from zephyr dropped to ~280, 5xx dropped ~87% immediately. Latency 95th started coming down.
Support-Alex: drafting customer message. Proposed: "We're seeing a large burst from your integration causing platform degradation. We've applied a temporary soft cap of 300 QPS to stabilize service. We'll work with you to tune limits — can you pause the hour job or stagger?" Want to @AE-Sam to confirm tone.
AE-Sam: tone good. Add ETA for next update in 30m. I'll try to get an urgent reply.
Product-Priya: FYI: this soft-cap will cause some of their requests to be queued/429'd. Are there high-priority endpoints we should allow through?
SRE-Josh: good point. We can whitelist their webhook callback route /v1/callbacks/priority with a higher per-route allowance. Running patch:```
infractl route-allow --org zephyr --route "/v1/callbacks/priority" --qps 50 --reason "critical callbacks"
```
ops-bot: OK — route allow applied (change-id: ch_2026_zephyr_002).
Oncall-Maya: monitoring: whitelisted route shows ~30 QPS and fully healthy. Overall cluster stability improved.
Incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4589. Pager duty on-call notified.
Support-Alex: Message sent to Zephyr (via support): "We've applied a temporary soft cap to stabilize service. If you can delay the hourly job for 1 hour that'll help; otherwise we'll coordinate tweaks. We're standing by."
AE-Sam: customer responded: "We're investigating — will throttle our job within 20 minutes." Good.
SRE-Josh: post-mitigation metrics: global 5xx rate down to baseline, p99 latency reduced by 30%. We should keep the soft cap for 30 minutes then reevaluate.
Oncall-Maya: Agree. Set reminder to re-evaluate at +30m. Also creating follow-up: run a per-org traffic profile audit for Zephyr and suggest batching/quantization options.
Product-Priya: please capture details in the incident doc: cause = unbounded batch job + long sequences; mitigation = org soft cap + route whitelist; customer impact = degraded returns and 429s for excess requests; next steps = engineering recommend prompt truncation + AE-runback with customer.
SRE-Josh: adding an ops note: we should consider auto-escalation rule: if an org > x10 baseline for >2m then auto-soft-cap to protect SLOs. Filing infra backlog ticket.
Oncall-Maya: handoff to next on-call @SRE-Josh at 1894501800 (30m). Current status: mitigated, monitoring.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: re-evaluate INC-2026-4589 at 1894501800.
Support-Alex: after chat with AE, customer will stagger jobs and monitor. We'll leave soft cap in place for 1 hour then remove if stable.
Oncall-Maya: removing myself from active — handing to Josh. If anything spikes back up ping me. :thumbsup:
SRE-Josh: taking over. Will coordinate rollback plan: infractl rate update --scope org --org-id zephyr --remove-limit --reason "post-mitig rollback if stable"
Incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.
Oncall-Maya: closing the live mitigation channel in 1h unless new alerts. Thanks team. :heart:
